mapping_notes: Annual exposure = $4,427,000 cumulative breach cost x 68% likelihood x 81% addressable = $2,438,391.60 (printed rounded to $2,438,392). The reduction is 70% / 75% / 80%.
aro_before = 0.68 x 0.81 = 0.5508, aro_after = 0 and adoption_by_year = 70 / 75 / 80 carries the reduction ramp; equivalent to reducing ARO by 70-80%.
The printed A4 'addressable with SES Complete 70%' is not used in the printed formula (A5 = A1 x A2 x A3), and we follow the printed formula.
ARO is a probability (68% chance of at least one breach), used as an expected count, as the study does.
